spec.text:
Cool, even early-morning daylight fills the rehearsal studio. A wooden barre lines the rear wall; the level floor is clear. Sela Nori stands with parallel feet and relaxed arms. A continuous, fixed three-quarter full-body view keeps her hands and both shoes visible throughout.

She steps her right foot a short distance forward, keeping it planted through recovery. She lowers into a comfortable crouch over her bent right knee, left palm flat on the floor just inside her right foot, right hand off the floor, left foot behind.

Pressing through her right leg, she lifts her left palm as her left foot steps farther back. She settles into a right-forward lunge, right knee bent, left leg extended behind with heel raised. Her left arm extends forward and her right arm reaches diagonally upward.

She holds the pose, then lowers her arms, lifts her left foot and steps it forward beside the right. She finishes upright ahead of her opening position. The room and camera remain still.

In a community exercise room, Lena Voss stands on clear, level floor, feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly outward, weight evenly supported and arms relaxed at her sides. The fixed camera holds a full-body side-three-quarter view from her front-right, keeping her entire body visible throughout one continuous shot.

Lena bends both knees and eases her hips back, bringing both forearms forward symmetrically with elbows bent. She lowers at a controlled pace into a comfortable two-foot squat, knees tracking over her feet. Both boot soles, including the heels, stay planted throughout; her torso inclines slightly forward for balance.

She holds the squat briefly and steadily, then presses through both feet, straightens her knees and hips, and returns upright while lowering both arms to her sides.

A locked full-body camera views a training room from a front three-quarter angle in one continuous, silent shot. Anika Sol stands centered on the mat, clearly identifiable, feet together and arms relaxed; she remains fully in frame throughout.

She steps her anatomical left foot backward, keeping her right foot planted forward. Bending both legs, she lowers her left knee onto the mat, right sole flat and left toes tucked behind her. Her medical coat hem clears the kneeling knee.

Supported by her left knee and right foot, she extends her left arm comfortably diagonally upward, torso upright and untwisted. Her right hand crosses her chest and rests visibly on her left upper arm. She holds briefly.

She releases her right hand from her left upper arm, then lowers both arms to her sides before rising through her right foot and tucked left toes. She lifts the rear left foot and steps it forward beside the right, finishing upright on the mat with arms relaxed.

A continuous, locked full-body three-quarter view shows Noor Hale alone in the clear floor space of a field-station exercise room, fully visible throughout. She stands upright, feet beneath her hips and arms relaxed.

Noor steps her anatomical left foot leftward, bending her left knee into a shallow side lunge while her right foot stays planted and her right knee remains softly unlocked. Leaning modestly toward her bent left leg without twisting her torso, she reaches her right hand across to rest on her left knee while extending her left arm leftward at shoulder height. She holds briefly, both boots flat on the floor.

Noor lifts her right hand clear of her left knee and lowers her left arm, relaxing both arms by her sides. Only then does she straighten and step her left foot back beneath her hip, returning to neutral standing.

In a rehearsal hall, Ivo Sen stands fully visible, feet comfortably apart and arms relaxed at his sides. He is alone and stays in frame throughout this continuous, silent scene. The locked camera holds a full-body three-quarter view from his front-left.

Keeping his feet planted and torso broadly steady, he raises both arms, bends his elbows and crosses his forearms before his chest. His anatomical left forearm is nearer the camera, briefly concealing a short section of his right forearm; his hands remain separate. He holds the crossed pose for a beat.

He smoothly uncrosses, revealing the concealed right-forearm section as the limbs separate. His anatomical left arm extends diagonally upward to his left; his anatomical right arm extends sideways to his right at shoulder height. He briefly settles into the open pose, then lowers both arms to a neutral position at his sides.

In a community room, a locked full-body camera frames Mara Vale from a front-right three-quarter angle, with space above her head and around both shoes. Mara is alone, identifiable from the opening and fully visible throughout one continuous shot.

On the clear, level floor, she stands with feet comfortably apart and arms at her sides. She extends her arms outward, then transfers weight onto her anatomical right foot, keeping its entire sole flat and supporting knee softly bent throughout the balance.

Keeping her torso upright, she raises her anatomical left knee modestly until her shoe clears the floor. She holds briefly, making small arm and supporting-leg corrections without hopping, pivoting or changing support feet.

She lowers her left foot beside her right, settling its sole. Only after both feet support her does she relax her arms to her sides, finishing steady.

A locked camera in a gallery-hall corner shows Lena Voss already front-facing on the clear floor in an unobstructed full-body view, arms slightly clear of her sides. Floor and wall junctions remain fixed.

Lena turns clockwise in place as viewed from above, reaching a left-facing profile, nose toward frame left, then a rear view. Her forehead scars disappear naturally as she turns away; her braid remains attached on her anatomical right throughout.

Continuing in the same direction, she reaches a right-facing profile, nose toward frame right, then completes the rotation to face the camera. She settles with both boots planted and her arms relaxed slightly away from her jacket. Lena remains entirely in frame throughout this single shot without dialogue; the camera never moves.

A locked, low-set camera holds a full-body view of a plain fitting studio with no mirror. Sela Nori stands facing the camera in the center of the fitting area, visible from head to sneakers. She is the only person present and remains entirely in frame throughout the continuous shot. There is no dialogue or cutting.

To display the bomber’s rear fit, she keeps her arms relaxed beside her body and turns counterclockwise as viewed from above. Small, natural steps and pivots carry her through a profile facing screen right, then into a rear-facing stance. She briefly holds with her back square to the camera, letting the bomber hang naturally.

Rather than completing a full circle, she reverses clockwise through the same right-facing profile until she faces the camera again. She settles with both feet planted in her original fitting position.

In a workshop inspection bay, a continuous, silent locked shot holds Ivo Sen alone and fully visible head to toe throughout, with clear floor around his shoes. He starts facing the camera. Several steps behind him, a waist-high inspection console has a tilted display showing a large illuminated inspection diagram without readable text; it never obscures him.

With arms relaxed at his sides, Ivo turns clockwise as viewed from above, head moving with torso through profile until his back faces the camera. He briefly studies the console.

Keeping torso and feet rear-facing, he turns only his head comfortably toward his anatomical left shoulder to check the clear floor in his return direction. Only a partial side view of his face appears, never a frontal face above his rear-facing torso. He realigns his head with his torso toward the console; only then does he turn his whole body counterclockwise, retracing the same profile to face the camera.

Afternoon in the costume workroom. Tomas Reed sits facing his workstation toward the camera in a low-backed, armless swivel chair with a broad, nonrolling pedestal on the level floor. A large garment-pattern board stands behind him, clear of the chair's turning space. A continuous, fixed full-body view keeps Tomas, the pedestal and both feet visible under even overhead light.

He pauses, then uses small foot steps to swivel counterclockwise, viewed from above. The seat and low backrest rotate together over the stationary pedestal. He passes through a clear profile until his back faces the camera and he faces the board; his upper back remains visible above the backrest.

After briefly inspecting the board's large shapes, Tomas reverses clockwise through the same profile to face his workstation and the camera again, ready to resume work. His feet reposition naturally throughout; his vest closure remains unchanged. There is no dialogue.

A rehearsal studio in one continuous, locked wide full-body view. Juno Pike stands alone, fully visible near the front-right of a taped route, facing the camera. The entire broad, open, oval-like curve is visible, with ample walking room, distinct endpoints and a finish farther camera-right than the start.

Juno Pike takes short forward steps clockwise as viewed from above, turning naturally with the route rather than sliding sideways. They curve toward frame-left through a clear frame-left-facing profile, then continue around the left portion until their back faces the camera, revealing the jacket’s back stripe.

Without pausing or reversing, they follow the far curve toward frame-right through the opposite, frame-right-facing profile, then round the final curve to face the camera again. Juno Pike stops front-facing at the separate finish and remains fully in frame from start to stop. No dialogue.

A locked, uncut full-body wide shot shows the compact wardrobe room. Kian Moss is alone, fully visible and front-facing beside the waist-high worktable at frame left. The rear garment display is a few clear steps behind him; the table is outside his path. Kian remains fully in frame and unobstructed; camera and zoom stay fixed throughout. There is no dialogue.

Kian turns counterclockwise, viewed from above, through profile until his back faces the camera. After completing the turn, he walks toward the display, gradually becoming smaller. He stops short of the garments and pauses to inspect them, sustaining the rear view. His hood stays down throughout, resting against his upper back; his cuff marker remains on his anatomical left wrist.

Kian reverses clockwise through profile to face the camera. Only after completing the turn does he walk back, gradually growing larger, and stop in his original work area beside the table.

At night in a quiet intake room, Anika Sol sits alone on the left, waiting for clearance with a neutral expression, her empty hands resting in her lap. Closed double doors stand on the right beneath one large circular status lamp, initially dark. Red means wait; steady green means clearance. A continuous fixed medium three-quarter view keeps Anika’s face and the lamp readable together throughout.

The lamp begins flashing vivid red. Anika looks diagonally upward toward it. Her eyes widen, eyebrows rise and lips part. Her shoulders tense as she waits.

The red flashing stops; the same lamp turns steady green. Only then do her shoulders relax and eyebrows ease, her parted lips softening into a relieved smile. She holds that expression, remaining seated and watching the green lamp. The doors stay closed and the room’s soft overhead illumination remains unchanged.

In the camera corner of a portrait studio, Sela Nori sits before a plain portrait backdrop. A continuous fixed medium close-up shows her head and upper torso; she is alone, clearly identifiable from the opening, and remains in frame throughout. There is no dialogue.

As a deliberate portrait warm-up, she practices a gradual smile, keeping her head steady and her gaze toward the lens. She begins neutral, her mouth resting naturally and her eyes calm. After a brief beat, her mouth corners lift into a small, clearly closed-mouth smile.

Without moving her head, she gradually broadens the smile into a warm, natural expression. Her cheeks lift gently while her eyes stay relaxed. She holds the broader smile for several beats.

A continuous fixed medium three-quarter view looks slightly down at Mara Vale at a pottery-workshop packing table, keeping her face, both hands and the mug's near rim readable during the reveal. Mara is already in frame and remains there throughout. No dialogue or cuts.

Neutral, Mara looks down at the upright, paper-wrapped ceramic mug, its handle accessible beside folded wrapping. Her anatomical left hand steadies the handle while her right gently peels the paper down, below her face. The paper clears the near edge, revealing a pre-existing rim chip. No loose fragment is present; neither hand touches the chipped edge.

Her gaze settles on the chip; her eyes widen in surprise and her hands stop. Surprise gives way to a disappointed frown with downturned mouth corners. Looking at the damaged rim, she holds the frown, left hand at the handle and right resting on the peeled-back paper.

Esme Park sits alone at a hobby table in a community craft room, already visible. One continuous fixed medium view keeps her face, hands, and small tabletop block arrangement visible throughout, without cuts or dialogue.

Neutral-faced, she aligns one block with her left fingertips while her right hand rests nearby on the tabletop. The moving block lightly brushes an upright neighbor, causing a slow, slight tilt within easy reach.

Her eyes widen in startlement. She stops adjusting and gently brings her right fingertips against the leaning block before it falls, easing it back until its base rests flat. The surrounding arrangement stays intact.

Her expression softens with relief, her right fingertips still lightly touching the now-stable block and the arrangement undisturbed.

In a craft studio, a fixed medium three-quarter view shows Juno Pike’s identifiable face and a storage desk’s open shallow drawer together. Juno is alone and stays in frame throughout. No dialogue or cuts.

Juno neutrally inspects the drawer, left hand on its edge, searching for a familiar keepsake: a palm-sized carved wooden bird already near the drawer’s center, completely concealed beneath loose cloth. The drawer stays supported by its runners.

With their right hand, Juno catches a cloth corner and draws it toward the drawer’s right side, uncovering the bird. Their hands stay low and their face unobstructed. Their gaze stops on it; eyebrows rise, eyes widen and lips part in surprised recognition.

Juno releases the cloth, leaving it gathered beside the bird, then gently lifts the bird with their right hand. Surprise softens into a warm smile as they hold it just below chest height, angled for them to see, face fully visible.

In a sewing workroom, Bela Rowan stands at a repair table, holding an unworn fabric swatch loosely in both hands. A continuous, fixed medium view keeps her face, hands and swatch visible above the tabletop throughout, without cuts or dialogue.

Bela inspects it neutrally. A loose thread at the repaired seam catches her attention; her eyebrows draw together in a suspicious frown as she pauses over the stitching.

Placing her fingertips on opposite sides of the seam, Bela gently spreads its edges. Light tension reveals a small, preexisting gap; no fabric tears or stitches break. Her eyes widen slightly and her brow briefly lifts in realization.

Her eyebrows then pull down into a deeper, frustrated frown, lips pressing firmly together. She holds the swatch steady with the gap visible, her disappointed gaze on the faulty seam.

A continuous fixed wide three-quarter view holds on an empty field-station room. No part of Noor Hale is initially in frame. The closed, unlatched door at left, clear connecting floor, and low inspection console at right remain visible. The door is hinged at its left jamb, with room to swing inward toward the left wall without blocking the route. The console is angled to keep Noor's face readable at the controls.

The door starts inward under pressure from outside. Noor Hale's right hand becomes visible pressing its outer face near the free edge at handle height. She pushes it clear of the passage, releases it, and crosses fully inside before walking right toward the console. The door stays open beside the left wall.

Her attention settles on the controls as she arrives. Noor stops close enough to examine them, facing the controls with her face readable in three-quarter profile. She remains in frame from her entrance through this final pause.

The gallery foyer is empty. A fixed wide view holds the open archway on the right and waist-high visitor welcome desk on the left. The arch, threshold and floor immediately inside are fully visible. The clear visitor approach crosses the open foyer between arch and desk. The desk’s right-hand end is unobstructed, with ample standing room behind it.

Lena Voss enters through the right arch and clears it completely, both boots beyond the threshold and her whole figure visible before she approaches the desk.

She walks left, passes around the desk’s open right-hand end with room to spare, and stands behind it, facing the visitor approach across the open foyer. She remains within the fixed frame throughout her entrance and walk, then holds her position behind the desk.

A locked, continuous wide shot opens on an empty repair shop. A clear aisle leads from the left frame edge to the collection counter at screen right. Parallel to the back wall, the counter has its customer-facing front toward the camera and unobstructed standing room before it. Shelves of repaired appliances stand behind it.

Ivo Sen walks briskly into view from the left frame edge, heading screen right toward the counter. His whole body clears the left frame edge well before he approaches it.

Ivo Sen reaches the customer side and stops walking, still facing screen right. Only then does he make a quarter-turn to his anatomical left, facing the counter toward the back wall. He remains there, fully in frame. No one else appears. No dialogue.

One continuous, locked wide view holds on an empty community hall. A fully open doorway is at frame right, a practice mat toward frame left, with a generous stretch of clear, level floor between them.

Tomas Reed enters through the right doorway at a light jog, his sneakers clearing the threshold and his shoulders and vest passing without contact. Once his whole body is inside, he continues jogging left toward the mat. The camera stays fixed, keeping him fully visible from head to shoes throughout his movement inside the hall.

Still several strides from the mat, Tomas eases into distinct, unhurried walking steps. He walks the remaining distance and stops just short of the mat, feet comfortably planted and posture alert, ready for his warm-up.

INT. MOVEMENT STUDIO - DAY

A secured practice wall has a low, wide padded opening at screen-left. A clean padded strip runs through it onto the level floor; an open practice area lies at screen-right. The fixed wide camera covers the opening and full route in one continuous shot. Nobody is initially visible.

Rafi Dune's hands and head appear at the opening, followed by his shoulders. He crawls on hands and knees with comfortable head and shoulder clearance until his entire body clears the wall.

Rafi Dune pauses on his knees, brings one foot forward into a half-kneel, then pushes up to standing. He walks to the open practice area and stops upright with relaxed arms. His clothing remains clean and unchanged; the wall and opening stay fixed.

A locked, full-body wide view holds on an empty stage area in a rehearsal room. Clear floor extends from the right frame edge to a frame-left stopping position, leaving ample room to slow down.

Practicing an enthusiastic arrival, Kian Moss jogs in from beyond the right frame edge with a neutral, focused expression. He becomes fully visible, head to toe, and continues right to left. Approaching the frame-left stopping position, he shortens his jogging steps, slows, and stops completely with space remaining before the frame edge.

After stopping, he turns from his leftward heading to face the camera. His focused expression opens into a broad smile, which he holds. His hood stays down throughout. The wide view remains unchanged in one continuous shot, without cuts or dialogue.

A continuous fixed wide shot, without cuts or dialogue, spans a quiet training ward. Anika Sol stands clearly visible at screen-left, looking toward the basin on the right-hand wall. A wide opaque divider occupies the center, extending above her head to the floor without a gap. An open rear path connects its ends; the entire route stays within frame.

Anika walks left to right behind the divider's left edge until her entire silhouette, including hair and boots, is concealed. She remains completely hidden across its broad center, then emerges at its right edge.

She continues to the basin and stops facing it in profile, her face identifiable and medical clothing clearly visible; the basin does not obscure her.

A locked wide three-quarter view holds the station corridor, from near-right foreground to an inspection panel on the far-left rear wall. Noor Hale stands clearly visible near-right in left-facing profile.

A broad opaque equipment enclosure stands between the camera and rear aisle. Its housing rises above Noor's head; a solid floor-level plinth closes any view underneath. Behind it, ample walking clearance accommodates a concealed bend from leftward travel into a diagonal farther left and away toward the panel. Noor's entire route remains within the fixed frame.

Noor walks left behind the enclosure's right end and disappears completely. Fully hidden, she follows the aisle around its bend, changing heading toward the panel.

She first reappears beyond the enclosure's farther-left end already moving diagonally away in rear-three-quarter orientation. Without another turn, she clears the enclosure and continues along that same diagonal to the panel, growing slightly smaller with distance.

A continuous locked wide shot holds an exhibition foyer with a seating alcove at right. Mara Vale stands fully visible and recognizable at left, arms relaxed at her sides. She is alone and stays in frame throughout. A broad display case stands in front of her unobstructed walking route. Its opaque body and backing conceal her torso and arms, relaxed or folded, leaving her head and shoulder tops visible. Recessed supports leave a narrow shoe-level gap. The bench stands beyond its right edge, clear of her route.

Mara walks left to right behind the case toward the alcove. Her relaxed arms and torso disappear progressively. Only once both arms are completely hidden does she fold them comfortably across her chest; neither hand nor forearm protrudes. Her head and shoulder tops keep moving above the case, her shoes visible through the lower gap.

From their first appearance beyond the right edge, her arms are already folded. She clears the case without adjusting or unfolding them and stops beside the bench, arms still folded.

A fixed wide view spans a tram terminal concourse. Esme Park is fully visible right of a floor-mounted schedule board, with an open departure doorway farther left. No one else is present.

The broad, opaque board stands nearer the camera than her route. Its top rises above her head; its solid base meets the floor without a gap. Clear walking space remains between board and wall. The entire route and doorway remain within the fixed frame.

Esme Park walks steadily right to left behind the board. Its right edge progressively conceals her until even her hair and shoes are hidden. She continues along the same path, physically within frame throughout the brief complete concealment. She emerges at its left edge, becomes fully visible again, continues left, and stops at the doorway threshold without passing through.

A continuous locked full-body wide three-quarter view holds a garden shed. Rafi Dune is clearly visible near-left, walking upright toward a workbench farther right and deeper inside.

A tall, broad plywood partition between Rafi and the bench reaches the floor without a gap. Behind it, a clear passage allows bending and travel toward its right edge; beyond that edge is the bench’s accessible low shelf.

Rafi moves left-to-right and away, still upright as he disappears completely behind the partition, head to shoes. He stays within the frame throughout. Only when fully hidden does he lower into a crouch.

At his first posture-readable reappearance at the farther-right edge, his torso is already lowered and both knees visibly bent. He clears the partition with short, alternating bent-knee steps, maintaining the crouch. Fully visible, he pauses crouched beside the lower shelf, looking into the storage beneath the bench.

INT. REHEARSAL ROOM – AFTERNOON

In an otherwise empty room, a secured opaque scenic panel spans the middle, with a clear, level walkway behind it. Its raised lower edge leaves passing shoes and lower legs visible while concealing torso and face.

One continuous, locked full-body wide shot frames Bela Rowan fully visible at screen-right, her readable face neutral in a comfortable three-quarter view, arms relaxed.

She walks leftward behind the panel, remaining neutral until her whole face is concealed. Her moving shoes and lower legs remain continuously visible beneath it. While her face is hidden, she forms a broad smile.

At the panel's left edge, her first readable face is already broadly smiling in a comfortable camera-facing three-quarter view, her head naturally angled to her path. Without stopping, she continues left until fully clear, maintaining the smile and relaxed arms. The panel and lighting remain unchanged.

A continuous fixed-camera shot frames Tomas Reed knees-up in a workshop vestibule beside a closed workshop door. He faces the camera, his face and open vest clearly visible.

He brings the vest edges together near his chest, aligning two large buttons on his right front panel with matching buttonholes on his left front panel. He guides the upper button through its matching hole and secures it, then fastens the lower button through its matching hole, closing the opening.

With both buttons secured, he releases both hands from the fastenings. He places his palms against the vest front, smooths downward, then lowers his arms to his sides. The vest stays closed.

He remains in place, visible knees-up throughout; nobody enters. There is no dialogue.

A continuous fixed medium three-quarter view shows Esme Park on a sheltered porch beside an open exit at frame right, her face visible and her hood down behind her neck. Light rain falls only beyond the shelter, leaving Esme and the porch beneath her dry.

Esme reaches back with both hands, each grasping the corresponding hood edge. She lifts it behind her head, clearing her hair, then draws it forward into place. The opening frames her unobstructed face, with silver hair still visible along her forehead and temples. She releases both edges and lowers her hands.

Only then does Esme turn her gaze toward the exit. The hood stays up unsupported. She remains dry in the same spot, continuously in frame; apart from the raised hood, her clothing and appearance remain unchanged.

Morning in the greenhouse potting room. Rafi Dune stands facing the dry potting bench against the rear wall. An empty tray lies flat on the worktop, a soft dry brush beside it. Space beside the bench stays clear.

The continuous fixed medium-wide three-quarter view keeps Rafi, both forearms, brush and tray visible. Daylight makes folds readable. Both sleeves initially reach his wrists.

Rafi uses his left hand to fold his right cuff upward, then folds it again. The roll stays below his elbow; his left sleeve stays down.

He releases the cuff and lowers his hands; the roll holds. Still facing the bench, he picks up the brush with his right hand and brushes the empty tray while his left steadies its edge. His right sleeve remains rolled, with no other clothing changes. He stays at the bench.

In a station vestibule, Juno Pike stands alone facing the fixed camera, clearly identifiable from the opening and continuously framed knees-up, with the jacket zipper clearly visible. The departure doorway is screen left, toward Juno's anatomical right.

Juno lifts the open jacket's lower fastening slightly to waist level. The right hand steadies the box and slider while the left fully seats the pin, then holds the base steady. The right hand pulls the slider upward, progressively joining the teeth from the bottom to the upper chest.

Juno releases the zipper, letting the hem settle over the hips, then smooths the closed front downward with both palms. With hands lowered, Juno turns only the head toward the doorway; the torso stays facing the camera and the jacket stays zipped closed.

In a utility washroom, Bela Rowan stands alone at the sink, clearly identifiable and in frame throughout. The continuous, silent, fixed medium three-quarter view includes her face, tap, hands, cuffs, basin and adjacent counter.

Bela holds a small reusable cup above the basin; her loose right cuff is dry and uniformly pale mint. With her left hand she opens the tap to a gentle stream, then holds the cup beneath it in her right hand. She rotates and tips the cup, rinsing its inside and emptying water into the basin. During rotation, her loose right cuff accidentally droops across the stream’s edge, forming a darker wet patch. Ordinary rinsing motion carries the cuff clear without deliberate sleeve dipping.

Bela sets the cup upright on the counter, releases it, then closes the tap with her left hand. Noticing the dampness, she raises and slightly turns her right forearm over the basin to inspect the cuff; the darkened patch remains plainly visible.

In one continuous fixed medium three-quarter view, Kian Moss stands clearly identifiable behind an art-studio workbench, alone and in frame throughout. A drawing board rests fully supported, slightly askew to the worktop's straight front edge. Beside it, a wide horizontal wooden ledge on Kian's right is visibly dusted with dry white chalk.

His right sleeve is clean. He steadies the board with his left hand and uses his right hand to adjust it. During the adjustment, the underside of his right sleeve brushes the chalk-dusted ledge.

He lifts his right forearm clear and turns it slightly palm-up, revealing a chalk streak on the sleeve's underside where it touched the wood. He pauses to inspect it; his left hand keeps steadying the supported board, and his left cuff band remains unchanged.

Kian resumes adjusting the supported board with his right hand while his left steadies it, keeping his right forearm clear of the chalky ledge. The streak persists.

A continuous fixed wide view shows a rehearsal hall with a wall-mounted barre across the right side of the rear wall. Only Sela Nori and Tomas Reed are present, both fully visible and identifiable at the opening. Tomas sits on a sturdy stool at far left, both feet on the floor and hands on his thighs; Sela stands left of center, well to his right.

Sela walks left to right along an unobstructed route, well clear of the stool. At the barre’s right-hand end, she turns toward the barre and stops facing it, ready without beginning an exercise.

Tomas remains seated, feet on the floor and hands on his thighs; he may blink or make small balance adjustments. Both remain within the fixed wide frame with separate silhouettes throughout. There is no dialogue or camera cut.

A fixed wide view holds a gallery with a solid, closed exit door on the left and a waiting bench against the rear wall, clear of the open walkway. Lena Voss stands at the right end of the walkway; Esme Park waits beside the bench in a relaxed, balanced stance, outside Lena Voss’s route. Both adults are clearly visible and identifiable.

Lena Voss walks from right to left along the unobstructed walkway to the door. Lena Voss stops facing its latch and looks at it, checking the exit without opening the door.

Esme Park remains standing beside the bench. Both remain visible within the fixed frame throughout the continuous scene.

A locked wide three-quarter view holds a training ward: a sturdy foreground chair on the left, a glass-doored supply cabinet showing stacked medical supplies against the rear wall on the right, and a clear aisle between them. Anika Sol stands near the camera to the chair’s right; Rafi Dune sits in it. Both are clearly identifiable at the opening and remain in frame throughout.

Rafi’s feet rest on the floor. He already holds a cup by its handle in his right hand just above his lap, the grip unobstructed.

Anika walks down the aisle toward the cabinet, receding and becoming smaller in the fixed view. During her walk, Rafi raises the cup to his mouth, pauses with the rim at his lips, then lowers it back to his lap without releasing the handle. He remains seated at the same location; the chair stays put. Anika stops directly before the cabinet only after he has lowered the cup.

A station room, in one continuous, locked, moderately distant full-body two-shot without zoom. Noor Hale stands rear left, facing the unoccupied foreground-left monitoring console. Juno Pike sits at the shallow right-side desk, looking down at its controls, both hands on the desk. Juno’s orientation permits a head-only look toward Noor and a right-palm acknowledgement visible to Noor. Both are identifiable initially and stay in frame; Juno’s legs and shoes remain visible beneath the desk.

The console angles beside Noor’s unobstructed path. Noor walks to its operating position and stops, approach and arrival plainly visible.

Only then, Juno turns the head toward Noor and raises the right hand broadly from the desk, open palm at shoulder height where Noor can see it. After a brief hold, Juno lowers the hand onto the desk. Juno stays seated in the same chair, torso placement and orientation unchanged apart from incidental balance corrections, without deliberate leaning or turning. Noor remains at the console.

A locked wide view keeps Ivo Sen and Bela Rowan fully visible head to shoes at the opening and throughout. The repair room’s workbench runs foreground to background, left of center; the tool rack is on the back wall beyond it. A clear aisle opens around the bench’s near end along its right side.

Ivo Sen stands near the foreground-left corner. Bela Rowan waits against the right wall outside the aisle, arms at her sides, both feet planted.

Ivo Sen crosses in front of the bench’s near end, clears its right corner, then turns away from the camera into the aisle, going around the bench rather than across its surface. He passes between the bench and Bela Rowan with ample clearance. Bela Rowan turns her head toward him, keeping both feet planted without following, then folds her arms across her chest, partially covering her anatomical right-chest pocket.

Ivo Sen continues to the tool rack and stops in front of it. Bela Rowan remains at the wall, arms folded. No dialogue or cuts.

Morning in a community room. The continuous, fixed wide three-quarter view shows a tall rear-right window admitting soft daylight, with no reflections of either person. No dialogue.

Mara Vale stands near the camera on the left. Kian Moss sits in a screen-left chair with an open book supported on his lap. The chair is outside the clear diagonal route to the window. Both remain in frame throughout.

Mara walks diagonally away toward the window; Kian stays seated with the book open. She stops beside the window and looks outside. Only then does Kian close the book with both hands, keeping it on his lap, then raise his head to look toward Mara.

Mara stays by the window. Kian remains seated holding the closed book; the chair never moves.

Exhibition preparation room, day. A clear aisle separates two work areas. At the opening, Lena Voss is fully visible beside the screen-left workbench, holding one lightweight closed folder. Anika Sol is fully visible at screen-right, arms relaxed. One continuous fixed full-body three-quarter view keeps both in frame, their faces and hands clear of furniture and the transfer unobstructed. Anika's left-chest badge and cross remain visible.

Lena walks across the aisle carrying the folder. Within comfortable reach, she presents it between them, holding one edge and leaving the other free. Anika securely grips the free edge; both briefly support the same folder. Only then does Lena release her edge and draw her empty hands back. Anika keeps holding it.

Lena turns toward the screen-left workbench and walks back to her work area, increasing their distance. Anika stays at her original location with the folder.
